audioMethod: Keep the owner-provided source soundtrack from t=0 through at least 0.4s after last detectable RMS speech activity; never reconstruct missing source phonemes or fabricate sentences.

sources.rightPanelRemoval: crop first-party source frame to x=20..1330
none; remove Notebook footer by safe y=0..700 crop and freeze before animated Notebook endcard

verification.method: mono-16kHz PCM RMS in 100ms bins, threshold 0.012; audio frame decoding and SHA readback required
verification.limitations: RMS cannot prove whole words or semantic sentence completeness, especially where source starts during speech (chapter 4). Human listener must confirm before publishing.
verification.voice: original source recording only; no eSpeak, Neural2 or new TTS
